description.short: Plan and manage Adobe Workfront work from Copilot Cowork
description.full: Connect Copilot Cowork to Adobe Workfront through Adobe's remote MCP server to find, inspect, create, and update work according to each user's Workfront permissions.

agentConnectors.description: Access projects, tasks, issues, documents, approvals, users, and other authorized Adobe Workfront data through Adobe's hosted MCP server.
